project.name: Clunk
project.summary: An open-source WebMCP appliance repair experience where a person and an AI diagnose a broken appliance together, inspect the exact component, and find the compatible part while the site enforces safety boundaries.
project.ai_usage: A compatible browser agent invokes eight WebMCP tools against deterministic page state. The shipped site does not call a model. Lovable was used for hosting and GitHub sync.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported scoping, implementation, debugging, accessibility, deterministic testing, live browser verification, and open-source and Devpost documentation.
